newsitem.title: CYPRUS: CAP. INTELLIGENCE GIVES RATING TO ABU DHABI BANKS.
newsitem.headline: CAP. INTELLIGENCE GIVES RATING TO ABU DHABI BANKS.

text.p: Cyprus based Capital Intelligence on Thursday assigned A minus long term and A-1 short term ratings to Abu Dhabi-based Union National Bank.
The ratings, said the agency in a news release, "reflect the bank's strong ownership, its sound financial position backed by its capable management and good disclosure levels".
UNB had total assets of $1.5 billion at end-1996.
Capital Intelligence said it was upgrading the long-term rating of Abu Dhabi Commercial Bank (ADCB) to A+ from A, reflecting the bank's improving operating financials.
The short-term rating has been retained at A-1, while the outlook remains stable, said Capital Intelligence.
ADCB has assets of over $4 billion and is Abu Dhabi's fifth largest bank.
